name: Born2Fro
headline: Your texture.
Your rhythm.
caption: Your texture deserves its own rhythm. Make space for a hair-care ritual that feels like you. Explore Born2Fro and find your next routine. #Born2Fro #NaturalHair #HairCareRoutine
rationale: A warm editorial palette, sculptural botanical forms and generous spacing create a calm, expressive hair-care direction. The language celebrates individual texture without promising product outcomes.

name: BATTERIQ
headline: More plans.
More power.
caption: The workday. The weekend. The next idea. Explore portable power with Batteriq and choose a setup for the way you move. #Batteriq #PortablePower #StayConnected
rationale: Electric lime against deep navy creates a strong technology signal. An original battery illustration and disciplined type hierarchy keep the message legible in a fast-moving feed. No unverified capacity or runtime claims.

name: DIANI ELITE TAXI
headline: Touch down.
Coast on.
caption: Arrive with the coast on your mind. Plan your next transfer with Diani Elite Taxi and keep the journey part of the experience. Visit the website to enquire. #Diani #CoastalTravel #AirportTransfer
rationale: A sunlit palette, flowing route line and illustrated coastal horizon communicate movement and arrival. The call to action invites an enquiry without inventing fares, availability or service guarantees.
